test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

First and second letter → (3) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

Second and third letter → (3) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So, Checking the options one by one:

​Option - (1): BEH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/979aac6c19f1ed454fe7a45dbacd5c8ba43f2d1e94af7056f21d9c5ef4210693.png] 

Option - (2): RUX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cbfecaa75816407a58be25fc2d348b1447438a59cc083065830fffd41b13488.png] 

Option - (3): KMP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59945836423094e61accc35abff2601f97d90788e2078054cb8c9defe7f0adc0.png] 

Option - (4): NQT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aa6ef118169c373c16d2d01f1ed2734cec97cb69a14e03ff6c0097b806e6d57.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "KMP" is the odd one out

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.
